Fast-pass confidence 87, no blockers, no blast-radius, no competing comments, single forced approach. Driver independently verified the crux code claims (buildUrl auto-scope, setSelectedKits omission, setFollowedDriver stats-only, backend contract + existing test).
synthesis: The admin Bird's-Eye map's 'Live Hits Pending Repossession' list has a fully-working, already-tested backend contract for kit_ids scoping (ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController@recentHits + scopedKits(); covered by ClarityScoutBirdsEyeControllerTest). lib/fetch.js buildUrl() already auto-appends the driver selector's selectedKitIds to every admin request. The gap is frontend timing/wiring: (1) map.js setSelectedKits() refreshes positions/paths/scan-paths/range-hits/stats on selection change but omits dashboard.fetchRecentHits(), so the pending list only catches up on the next ~10s poll tick instead of instantly; (2) click-to-follow (setFollowedDriver/clearFollowedDriver) scopes only the STATS tiles (App.vue 'Showing only X's stats' badge) and never the pending list, and buildUrl only special-cases followedKitId for the /dashboard/stats path, not /dashboard/recent-hits. Fix = wire fetchRecentHits into the admin selection mutation points + extend buildUrl's stats-only follow special-case to also cover recent-hits. Zero backend changes.

scope.summary: Frontend-only: wire the already-scoped /dashboard/recent-hits fetch into the two admin selection mutation points that skip it (setSelectedKits, setFollowedDriver/clearFollowedDriver) and broaden buildUrl's follow-priority special-case from stats-only to also include recent-hits. No backend/migration/schema change.

proposed_changes.change: In setSelectedKits(ids), add dashboard.fetchRecentHits(dashboard.range) to the existing Promise.all (alongside fetchDriverPositions/Paths/ScanPaths/RangeHits/fetchStats) so the pending list refreshes immediately on combobox selection change.
proposed_changes.reason: setSelectedKits refreshes every other admin-scoped surface on selection change but omits recentHits — the AC1/AC2 lag for the combobox interaction.

proposed_changes.change: In setFollowedDriver(kitId) and clearFollowedDriver(), add dashboard.fetchRecentHits(dashboard.range).catch(()=>{}) alongside the existing fetchStats() call. [CONTINGENT on Q1 answer including click-to-follow]
proposed_changes.reason: Follow-click scopes stats only; the pending list is never follow-scoped — the most literal match for Eric's 'click a kit and see where it is'.

proposed_changes.change: In buildUrl(), broaden the follow-priority check from isStats (path.includes('/dashboard/stats')) to also match '/dashboard/recent-hits', so a followed driver narrows the pending list too. [CONTINGENT on Q1 answer including click-to-follow]
proposed_changes.reason: Without this, the setFollowedDriver fetchRecentHits call resolves to selectedKitIds/org-wide, not the single followed driver.

questions.q: Does 'select a driver/kit' cover (a) the DriverSelector filter combobox only, (b) the map-click 'follow' interaction only, or (c) both? Both currently under-scope the pending list (combobox = up-to-~10s lag; follow-click = never scoped). Recommend BOTH (shared low-risk backend contract; ~3 small edits across 2 files).
questions.answer: BOTH interactions — scope the pending list on the DriverSelector combobox (instant refresh on selection change) AND on map click-to-follow (mirror the existing stats scoping). All 3 contingent edits are now in scope.

questions.q: Could adding fetchRecentHits() to setSelectedKits/setFollowedDriver/clearFollowedDriver regress the driver (non-admin) app, given DashboardOverlay.vue/stores/dashboard.js are shared?
questions.answer: No. setSelectedKits is only invoked from DriverSelector.vue (v-if=mapStore.adminMode). setFollowedDriver/clearFollowedDriver are only invoked from ScannerMap.vue for markers sourced from mapStore.driverPositions (admin-only). The driver app never reaches these functions. buildUrl's recent-hits change is inside the ADMIN_MODE branch only.

notes: Backend already fully correct + tested for kit_ids scoping across driverPositions/driverPaths/scanPaths/hits/stats/recentHits via the shared scopedKits() helper — this ticket is frontend-only wiring.
